curve_engine.evaluator: FUN_272275f84 (Automation.value(at:)) - value = startValue + y(p)*(endValue-startValue); y per curveByte

ease-in-4.note: byte class EXACT; exact byte inside class not distinguished

ease-out-4.note: byte class EXACT; exact byte inside class not distinguished

constant_power.provable_from_resource: GAIN ramps only: outgoing out_gain 1->0 with easing "ease-in-0.5", incoming out_gain 0->1 with easing "ease-out-0.5" (style 2: incoming placement starts at relative 0.75, style offset relative=1 offsetInSeconds=-0.3)
constant_power.derivation: IF curveByte 0x00 y=1-sqrt(1-p) and 0x40 y=sqrt(p) are applied (STRONG_INFERENCE join), outgoing gain=sqrt(1-t), incoming gain=sqrt(t), sum of squares = 1
constant_power.derivation_status: INFERRED / NOT FOUND as an explicit encoded equal-power formula
constant_power.equal_power_cos_sin: REJECTED: no pi/pi2/0.7071/1/sqrt2 (float64 or float32) in _SonicKit_MusicKit_Packages, _SonicKit_MusicKit, SonicKit (independent byte scan) and prior RED_TEAM_AUDIT §4.2

fallback_behavior.resource_missing: SmartTransitionsError tag 0xd (internalError, STRONG_INFERENCE), log "Transition style catalog JSON resource missing..."
fallback_behavior.fallback_style_binding: NOT FOUND; association fallback -> style 4 (Ease-in Ring-out) is INFERRED only, do not hardcode

notes: All numeric values are copied verbatim from the resource; no interpolation or unit conversion was invented.
style 0 (Gapless): incoming out_gain ramp is 1->1 (input already open); outgoing ramp placement starts at relative 1 with offsetInSeconds -0.3.
style 3 (overlap) has empty outgoing/incoming instruction arrays and no offset/duration.
style 33 (overlap + Reverb) and 44 (Ease-in Ring-out + Reverb) share identical outgoing AUReverb2 ramp blocks.
style 10 contains the only mapped values in the whole catalog: parameterName "beat_length" (2 occurrences, start/end of fx_delay_delay_time).
duration key present only for styles 8 (8), 9 (8), 12 (16); Swift field is maximumBarCount (Int?) - key<->field mapping STRONG_INFERENCE, unit NOT FOUND.
offset key present for 12 styles; absent for id 3 and id 33. offsetInSeconds nonzero only for style 0 (0) and style 2 (-0.3).
The equal-power cos/sin formula is not present in the resource or the AutoMix binaries; see constant_power.
